notes.title: Garden of the Sea 1.0 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Omg! Hurrah! Yay! Wow![/h1]

But... is this it? The end?

Heck no. This is a critical juncture, a tipping point. Our little Garden of the Sea is all grown up and getting out of its nest. Will it fly? Will it fall?

This game has been in the making for several years, with disruptions when the team has been pulled into other projects to meet deadlines or simply to help bring other projects forward. Between action packed portal parkour and nerve-racking horror, Garden of the Sea has been a splash of color and a haven to unwind in. Throughout, we have been thinking "What if someone else makes this game before us? What if someone beats us to it?" but in the end it just didn't matter. We needed to make this game, and while doing it, doing things differently from how we have worked in the past. 

We have learned so much and improved upon ourselves alongside the game itself. We absolutely adore Garden of the Sea and the world that it has grown into, and hope with all our hearts that Garden of the Sea will be received with as much joy as we have put into it – and that it makes sense to dig even deeper into the features we have already created, and add more content and updates for a long time. 

Okay, enough sentimentality! Let's see what is new since the last update.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Biome: Bamboo Island, including its own special creature
[*] Full Story (including an "ending"!)
[*] PC Graphics Update
[*] Ocean Update
[*] Dynamic shadows
[*] Grass Galore
[*] Leafy Leaves
[*] Achievements
[*] New music
[*] Audio Improvements
[*] Final House Upgrade
[*] New Breedable Animals
[*] Performance Improvements
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] New crafting recipes
[*] New tutorial
[*] New merchant items
[*] Localization for 22 different languages
[*] Auto-save functionality
[*] Improved grabbing & interactions with items in the world 
[*] Credits
[*] In-game camera functionality
[/list]

[h3]Localization & Accessibility[/h3]

The game is extensively localized and can be played standing or sitting down, in big or small play spaces, lowering the threshold of entry for as many prospective players as possible. The game allows for teleportation, smooth locomotion, smooth and snap turn, all at adjustable speeds. Audio is highly encouraged, but not required!

Languages available are, in alphabetical order: Arabic, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.


[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[b]What will happen after release? [/b]
We will continue updating the game for as long as it makes sense for us as a studio. We love adding new content and updates for already existing players as much as we love making it. As long as the game is bringing in new players too, we can keep doing what we love. 

[b]Can I continue playing with my save file from Early Access? [/b]
No, save files from older versions of the game are not compatible with this release. However, this is the last time that you'll lose progress. All future updates will be compatible with 1.0 save files or have a way to migrate save files safely.

[b]Any plans on multiplayer?[/b]
Oh, we wish, but it's just such a huge project to undertake. If we have the resources to look into it, we could investigate if and how it would work, but that would definitely be in the future. 

[b]Will Garden of the Sea release on X platform?[/b]
Possibly if there is enough of an audience! If you want to see Garden of the Sea on another VR platform, make sure to be loud about it and make yourself heard and we might see what we can do in the future!

[b]Where are my save files located?[/b]
On Quest they should be in:
This PC\Quest 2\Internal shared storage\Android\data\com.NeatCorporation.GardenoftheSea\files\Saves

And on PC They should be in:
“C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Neat Corporation\Garden of the Sea

[b]Will the price increase even more?[/b]
No, there are no plans to increase the pricing any further. 

[b]Where do my ingame photos end up? Can I save them?[/b]
Photos taken with the in-game polaroid camera can now be accessed outside the game in the folder “C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Neat Corporation\Garden of the Sea\Polaroids”


Until the next update, we wish you a wonderful time in Garden of the Sea! If you want to share screenshots of your garden or a fun moment you found, we'd love to see.

[i]Love from team Garden of the Sea[/i]

notes.title: Ready For Release Early 2022
notes.content:
[h3]Hi again everyone![/h3]

We're back and we're looking as fancy as ever as we're finally ready to share that sweet release window of ours!

You've probably noticed that we have given the Steam Store page an overhaul which will remain with us until launch. This means new videos, new screenshots and new store text. Phew! What do you think? We would love to hear your thoughts.

But first, let's recap what we announced during the UploadVR Showcase!

[h2]We're also launching on Quest 2[/h2]
You who watched the UploadVR Showcase with us might also have heard we've decided to include the Oculus Quest 2 as one of our launch platforms. Some of you may already have guessed this, but we hope you're just as excited as us that we're finally joining the Quest family (because we know a lot of you have been asking for this for some time now ♥)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]
[h3]Missed the UploadVR Showcase?[/h3]
Fear not! You can see our spot bellow and get a preview of how the game will look on Oculus Quest 2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3d-v6Erxkyc
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

[h3]PCVR is still getting the love it deserves[/h3]
We know most of you here on Steam are only here for the PCVR version and we're working on a trailer for you all as well which will showcase what the game will look at launch for you (and perhaps a comparison? We hear those are all the rage these days!).

But that will probably not reach you all until later in December and we know you all are dying to see what we have in store, so in the meantime; Have some of our more [b]current PCVR screenshots[/b]. Hype!

Now, let's get into what you're all actually here for:

[h2]Garden of the Sea will launch soon! Like 2022 soon![/h2]
First of all, the quick facts and details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]
[h3][b]When?[/b] Very early 2022[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

[h3]What happens next? [/h3]
We are currently going through rigorous QA, fixing bugs and continuing to polish all the little things. Releasing on both PC VR and Oculus Quest 2 means a bigger potential player base, which in turn means we can keep updating and adding to the game for longer! In addition, we are put to more intense scrutiny when it comes to bugs and playability, ultimately leading to a better game for everyone. We consider this a real win-win. 

[h3]Localization & Accessibility[/h3]
The game is extensively localized and can be played standing or sitting down, in big or small play spaces, lowering the threshold of entry for as many prospective players as possible. The game allows for teleportation, smooth locomotion, smooth and snap turn, all at adjustable speeds. Audio is highly encouraged, but not required!

Languages available are, in alphabetical order: Arabic, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]


As we get even closer to launch, we are preparing a bunch of fun events and raffles for both old and new faces! Stickers? T-shirts? Mugs? What would you like to see?

As always we're available both here on Steam and on our own Neat community Discord server and we're always listening, so don't be afraid to say hi!

notes.title: We're Leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow gardeners![/h3]

As the team hunkers down to get ready for launch of the ever fabled “1.0”, [b]we are here to give you a quick update[/b] on the goings-on for Garden of the Sea. And oh, boy is there a lot going on right now?!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]


[h2]We’ve picked a release window, and we’re about to share it with you all![/h2]
That’s right! We’ve finally decided [b]it’s time to reveal when we’re planning to launch[/b] and officially leave Early Access!

In about a week from now, [b]we are excited to be part of the UploadVR Showcase[/b], in which we’ll make some exciting announcements along with dropping that sweet, sweet ETA we know you all have been waiting for!

The UploadVR Showcase [b]will take place on December 2nd[/b], so be sure to add it to your calendar and bookmark the link so you don’t miss it!

You can read more about the showcase in their post here:
https://uploadvr.com/upload-vr-showcase-december-2


[h3]There will also be another post here on Steam![/h3]
For you who won’t be able to watch the showcase [b]we will also be posting here on Steam[/b] on the same day (which will also be a bit more personalized for you who’ve been following and supporting the game here on Steam).

You may have noticed that [b]there were a lot of changes in the last update[/b] and we realize we may not have been fully clear in exactly what has been going on with some parts of the graphics in the game: The update in visual fidelity is [b]just a byproduct of the massive rework[/b] that was done around the launch of that update.

We want the game to be [b]playable on as many hardware setups as possible[/b] and therefore decided we needed to do a small rework as we added the day-night cycle. Shadows and water were two of the highest impacted features and had to be rebuilt from scratch. What you’re seeing is the result of us [b]starting with the weakest hardware[/b] and then working our way up from there. We've already managed to bring back some of that sweet, sweet eye-candy and will be showing you some screenshots of what that looks like next week on December 2nd!


[h2]Other updates coming on the 2nd of December[/h2]
At the same time as our announcement next week, you’ll also notice [b]some updates here on the Steam store[/b]. So be on the lookout for our new artwork that we think will pop nicely in your Library, such as high end PC graphics screenshots and more!

Along with this the game will also be [b]bumped to its final price point[/b] which it will keep through launch. As always; this won’t affect existing players who have already purchased the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]


But enough teasing! We’ll see you in December with the full update! (And screenshots, screenshots, screenshots!)

notes.title: Coral Island and Day/Night Cycle Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Now we can all howl at the moon and enjoy the small tapping feet of baby puffkins running around everywhere![/h3]

The day has come! After much tinkering and tweaking [b]it's time to release the new Coral Island [/b]and[b] day-night cycle [/b]to early access for all of you to enjoy!

[i]Oh-boy[/i] was this a huge one! We merged this update with our internal Alpha milestone which means that [b]all the core gameplay systems are in place[/b] (wow omg). It was a lot of work, but we got there! New features and improvements will of course be added to the game as we keep working towards that ever glowing "1.0 release" - but we have quite literally never been closer than this.

Garden of the Sea is taking shape and starting to feel like a [i]proper game[/i] and we are so excited to get to that finish line (and beyond)!

Without further ado, let's dive into what this update brings to the game;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3ac9d2b6b455fb0052996c45b3e1b3af1a35dcb.png[/img]
[h2]Save breaking changes ahead![/h2]

Much is changing in this update so sadly you'll have to start a new save game, but you'll be happy to hear that [b]this is the last save-breaking change that will be released until we leave early access![/b]

Making (and saving) games is a tricky process and we thank you for your patience in this! ♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

GOSH, What hasn't been changed in this update? It sure feels like everything got a bit of an improvement. Let's dive into all the new mechanics and features!

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c70cf43c26bfb5d8287f579c7681a41c2546f769.png[/img]
[h3]New Biome: Coral Island[/h3]
Explore yet another [b]new island with a completely unique biome[/b]! Coral Island is shrouded in a permanent eclipse and brings new nocturnal plants and creatures for you to encounter.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/a7907ffe5cc44af977fe4bd5fa21342015d52e4d.png[/img]
[h3]A Dynamic Day/Night Cycle[/h3]
Time no longer stands still in Garden of the Sea! You can now enjoy [b]a full range of colors[/b] as the sun moves through the sky, granting us those [b]fiery sunsets[/b] we all love to snap photos of on our in-game camera. We also have a calm and cozy night-time with fireflies and warm glowy lamps for all you night-owls out there! ;)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/965a683aaa16210f03b7d4b6ea6d924b7bd84dfb.png[/img]
[h3]Creature Breeding[/h3]
In our mission to [b]expand creature interactions[/b] we have now introduced a [b]breeding[/b] feature! With this new update you can build barns for each creature type which will then allow you to fully tame them and in turn allow them to - *ahem* - multiply. Look at those cute baby animals though! Who could resist such a cutie?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c7d18889368bb6d5474dc7cad81c96a7ebcefc60.png[/img]
[h3]Unique Creature Variations[/h3]
But what is breeding without Individuality?! [b]Each animal now has a unique color and other visual identifiers[/b] so you can tell your little buddies apart and keep track of which one (JEFF!!!) keeps eating all the turnips. How fab!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/397f12213a08d95b71f0a04f9337e7907552d78d.png[/img]
[h3]Cooking[/h3]
We know you've been waiting for this one! Well, wait no further! [b]cooking is finally here[/b]! We're starting out with a few base recipes for you to try out while we go back to fully fleshing out the new system. Now, I just wish for a next-gen 3D printer that can print me edible versions of all those dishes. Some of them look truly delicious!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/41981729ebc2634e70611028bf3227e16d96716c.png[/img]
[h3]New Tutorial Area[/h3]
Starting a new game will now bring you through a [b]brand new tutorial quest[/b] in order to help [b]introduce new players to our crafting and gardening systems[/b]. It's also a great opportunity for stacking up on some useful plants before building your tent/home (nudge nudge, hint hint). ;)


[h2]Additional New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Creature affection system with tiers and rewards.
[*] New Barn building quests that ties into the new breeding system.
[*] Revamped quest chains to further allow the players to control the look of their home islands.
[/list]
[h2]Visual Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Environment visual overhaul on water, sky and foliage.
[*] Light sources at night.
[*] Updated/Improved icons to better match the art style.
[/list]
[h2]Updates to underlying systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements to the save system.
[*] Faster in-game loading of other islands.
[*] Lots of work on performance. (whew. so much)
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updates and improvements to the Crystal Island quest line.
[*] Improvements to grabbing large objects (like furniture).
[*] Improvements to interaction with seed bags - added alternative way to release a seed from the bag by pressing a button instead of physically shaking the bag.
[*] Added counter to inventory bubble that shows how many empty slots that remains.
[*] Improvements and bug fixes for the smooth locomotion system.
[*] Finger tracking for Valve Index controllers now works properly.
[*] Various improvements and bugfixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

And as always: your thoughts, ideas and feedback are always welcome. You can always reach us here directly on Steam or join our [url=http://discord.gg/NeatCorp]official Discord server[/url] to get first access to the latest news and community events.

[url=http://discord.gg/NeatCorp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/5c53bb6ddcfc8469d52eeddb56980c245348c3ec.png[/img][/url]


Until the next update,
[b]// The Neat GotS team[/b]

It's been a long wait but the next update is finally on the horizon and oh do we have news for you! We hope you are as excited are we are as we are about introduce [b]a completely new tutorial quest, a day-night cycle, a whole new island, cooking, and last but not least: animals taming and breeding[/b] in Garden of the Sea!

The update will go live on the [b]experimental branch[/b] today but should reach the regular branch [i]soooon[/i], we promise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c70cf43c26bfb5d8287f579c7681a41c2546f769.png[/img]
[h2]Unveil the secrets of Coral Island[/h2]
With this update we're adding yet [b]another island with its own unique biome and quests[/b]. Explore the depths of this under-yet-over the sea island to unveil the secrets within.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/a7907ffe5cc44af977fe4bd5fa21342015d52e4d.png[/img]
[h2]Watch your island come alive with the brand new day-night cycle[/h2]
We're introducing a dynamic [b]day-night cycle[/b] into the game! Enjoy fishing to a golden sunrise or take a nap in the grass in the sunset. The world of Garden of the Sea has never felt this alive!


[h2]Build deeper connections with your animal friends[/h2]
The animals in Garden of the Sea are very dear to all of us and with this update we intend to [b]expand interactions with them further[/b]. Caring for your animal friends will in the next update allow you to [b]tame them[/b] and [b]build a relationship[/b] with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c7d18889368bb6d5474dc7cad81c96a7ebcefc60.png[/img]
[h3]New unique color system[/h3]
Tired of all the Manateecows looking the same? Sulk no longer as we'll introduce a [b]new color system[/b] that will make each new animal more unique and recognizable. Now you'll finally be able to tell if it's "Kyle" or "Katie" who walked all over your crops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/965a683aaa16210f03b7d4b6ea6d924b7bd84dfb.png[/img]
[h3]Nurturing & Breeding[/h3]
With this update we'll also introduce breeding which will be a [b]new way to introduce more animals to your island[/b].

Aside from [b]new animals coming to visit your home island[/b], you'll also be able to expand upon your animal family through the [b]brand new breeding feature[/b]. Build a barn and watch your island get filled with the most adorable little animal babies - each with their own special traits and features.


[h3]All this and more![/h3]
Stay tuned for the final update post once we go live to get the full list of new features and fixes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

If you're one of those who likes to dive in and [b]get an early preview through our Experimental Branch[/b] you'll be happy to hear we're sticking to that ritual for this update as well.

The first iteration of the upcoming update will be live on the Experimental Branch today. But as always, [b]please be aware it's early alpha content and hasn't gone through much testing, bug fixing or polish yet[/b].

notes.title: New island update out now!
notes.content:
[h3]Great news gardeners, the new island is finally here![/h3]

We've done loads of tweaking and re-planning and we've finally reached a place where we're happy to consider it ready for [b]Early Access[/b].

We want to start with giving a quick shout-out to everyone who joined in and tested while we worked on this update on the Experimental Branch. Your feedback has been invaluable and we hope you've enjoyed watching this island take shape as much as we loved building it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3ac9d2b6b455fb0052996c45b3e1b3af1a35dcb.png[/img]
[h2]This patch contains changes that will break your save files![/h2]

Due to the complexity of the changes made while adding a whole new island we've unfortunately have had to implement changes that will break your current save files.

Even if they might load for you, [b]many features might be broken on old save files[/b] and we can’t guarantee that all the game systems will function correctly. We strongly recommend that you [b]start a new game to ensure that everything works[/b] as intended.

Breaking saves like this is sadly one of the risks of early access and we are doing our best to avoid it, but at times it can’t be helped. Thanks for bearing with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]


Now, without further ado; say hello to [b]Crystal Island[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/11530244161892deb0089bac2667756112d5b77b.png[/img]

[h2]Uncover the secrets of Crystal Island[/h2]
Just a bit off the coast of your home island you'll find this [b]new mystical island[/b] covered with hot springs, red crowned trees and some [b]naturally growing crystals[/b] scattered about. The environment here is harsh as an [b]invasive moss covering the ground makes it hard for crops to find space to grow[/b]. If you find a patch with tillable soil you'll find that the minerals present [b]will give the plants new and unique colors[/b], so trying to find ways to sustain your plants here may be quite worth your while.

With Crystal Island you'll also find [b]a new quest chain[/b] focused on environmental puzzles and unlocking [b]new abilities[/b]. Watch and listen to the land around you and find your way to the center of the island where you'll find the first glimpse of the history of this ancient world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/91da631ecb7c560e38a02ede9ff6808053b29400.png[/img]

[h2]Travel faster and further with the new Crystal Teleport feature[/h2]
Use the crystals on Crystal Island to upgrade your gloves, [b]unlocking the power to quickly move from crystal to crystal[/b] and allowing you to [b]teleport further than ever before[/b]. Use your wits and uncover new recipes and materials that will allow you to [b]bring this newfound ability back to your home island[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/cc5a03740d4a19946878d573ae037f4402973dba.png[/img]
[h2]Meet new animal friends[/h2]
With this new island we're also [b]introducing a new animal[/b]. Native to the Crystal Island and with a love for all things shiny, these fellas know how to live in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]
[h3]Want to help give this little fellow a name?[/h3]

We love involving our community in the decision process and we see this as a great opportunity to h[b]old another naming contest![/b] Get yourself ready and keep your eyes peeled as [b]we'll post an update for each phase of the contest[/b] with all the info on how to join.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/887bf3ea9fd1d708a8e64c8d5d8a075722c7af79.png[/img]

[h3]Contest Phase 2 is live! Join it below:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1086850/view/3030333493798251294

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/dfe7fc4ff7d33e2e4e810a0aebf8d8ed940d11ea.png[/img]

[h2]Spring has arrived[/h2]
With this update we're also [b]leaving the white frosty grass behind to move into the greener horizons of spring[/b]. We've heard many of you have been looking forward to the end of winter so I think this will be some welcome news for you. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/1cdf281b596082247af5abc05094322dd7b17f6a.png[/img]

[h2]What else is new?[/h2]
We've also added [b]new fish types, new resources, tools, craftable items and more[/b]! Among the highlights you'll find that [b]you can now craft a grass seed bag[/b] which will allow you to [b]re-grow grass on previously tilled soil[/b]. We've also added a craftable [b]water pump[/b] which will make the chore of refilling your watering can much less cumbersome.

We've added a [b]full patch note list at the very bottom of this post[/b] for you who love to stay in the know but you're also always welcome to jump in blind and uncover all the new features as you go. Regardless of method we hope you'll enjoy what you'll see!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]


That's it for this update! Remember to keep your eyes peeled for the next post launching our naming contest. It should be up in a day or so.

And as always: your thoughts, ideas and feedback are always welcome. You can always reach us here directly on Steam or join our [url=http://discord.gg/NeatCorp]official Discord server[/url] to get first access to the latest news and community events.

[url=http://discord.gg/NeatCorp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/5c53bb6ddcfc8469d52eeddb56980c245348c3ec.png[/img][/url]


With love,
[b]// The Neat GotS team[/b]

notes.title: It’s Time To Leave The Nest
notes.content:
Hello fellow gardeners!

Up until now home island has been the only place to explore in the world of Garden of the Sea and it will always be the center of your stay, but soon a new silhouette will appear on the horizon and the time has come to look beyond our nests and explore the sea.

It’s time to finally share what we’ve been working on lately: the next content drop includes a whole new island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/352abcdd74133ea4bb1b57966042bf65285032e5.png[/img]

[h2]Welcome to an island filled with secrets[/h2]

A mystical island covered with hot springs and a special invasive breed of moss that will give some extra hurdles for you to overcome in order to grow crops. You’ll also encounter some new plant varieties and other new secrets to uncover. Legends say this island is not quite what it seems, so make sure to keep your eyes and ears peeled as you survey its shores.

Will you figure out the secret hidden at the heart of the island or will you simply use the newfound world to harvest new materials? The choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/bace7eabce3a3155e9b35e28259fef11afcb1aac.png[/img]

[h2]New features and items[/h2]

Just like last time we’re also dropping a bunch of new features and items along with this update. Among these additions you will find the water pump, the trash can and a whole new (and rather secret) way to travel.

[h2]Embracing the “Way Too Early Access”[/h2]

With this update we are diving even deeper into the “way too” of our Early Access launch. There may be a few more noticeable kinks here and there as we’re adding all the new features as they are being built and at times with little to no polish. This process is awesome for gathering valuable feedback that will actually make an impact to the final game, but perhaps not as awesome for stability and overall feel of quality.

The first iteration is going live on the experimental branch today for you who want to get that extra early look so if you do switch over to the experimental branch to test it out we’d love to hear your feedback.

However; experimental branch or not, we’re always interested in hearing what you think about our games. We read every comment here on the Steam forums and we’re active every single day on our Discord server so feel free to pop in and say hello: [url=http://discord.gg/NeatCorp]Join the Neat Corp Discord server[/url].

Thanks for being a wonderful community ❤︎
// The Neat GotS Team

notes.title: Merchant Update Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello gardeners!

We are excited to announce that [b]the Merchant Update has officially been released[/b]! With it comes [b]house upgrades[/b], an [b]updated plant system[/b], a [b]composting box[/b] and a sweet bunch of [b]new decoration items[/b] for both your garden and your home. But that’s not all! Read on for a deep dive into each new feature or scroll all the way to the bottom for the full patch notes.

But first, a small (but actually rather large) notice:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/cf952ff5db20cb3c2d7aa4b4cb8d82ba40b11b33.png[/img]
[h2]This patch contains changes that will break your save files![/h2]

Major changes to gameplay systems made for the Merchant Patch will render your previously saved game sessions incompatible with the new update. Even if they might load for you, [b]many features might be broken on old save files[/b] and we can’t guarantee that all the game systems will function correctly. We strongly recommend that you [b]start a new game file to ensure that everything works[/b] as intended.

Breaking saves like this is sadly one of the risks of early access and we are doing our best to avoid it, but at times it can’t be helped. Thanks for bearing with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

With that out of the way, let’s move on to the sweet new stuff we’re giving you!

[h2]The Merchant has arrived[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/bcd9ef3dab62300864e94ab0fe2c3d1c82c5dd35.gif[/img]
The Merchant has finally woken up from his nap and he’s here to stay! Be sure to swing by for a look at what’s in stock regularly, because he likes to [b]update his stock with new items every day[/b]!

On the Merchant’s trading ship you’ll [b]use your farmed resources to trade for a long range of items[/b] and decorations that will allow you to further personalize your island. The Merchant stocks everything from alarm clocks to pots. He even carries [b]pattern rolls[/b] which will enable you to [b]update the fabric of your curtains and pillows[/b], allowing you to max out your house decoration game even further!

[h2]Upgrade your home from a simple tent to the home of your dreams[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/fa82e70489a2dd4cc353158ed568ea93afe9a533.png[/img]
For all your living needs we’ve added a li'l questline for [b]upgrading your house[/b] from a humble tent into a cozy cabin which has more room and wall-space for storage and decorating! In the largest home you can also [b]customize the colors of the walls, floors and roof[/b] using the Jellyfish painting blobs, so go wild!

[h2]Clean up that mess with new storage solutions[/h2]
Is your island as messy as mine? Are seed bags scattered all over the floor and is there a pile of long forgotten harvested vegetables resting at the bottom of the pond? With the [b]new storage solutions[/b] we’re adding it will be easier than ever to organize your items!

After you’ve upgraded your home, you’ll find a [b]neat little chest[/b] that can [b]store items in bubbles[/b] similar to the ones in your inventory. We’ve also added additional [b]shelves with similar storage capacities[/b].

For you who like to keep your items out on display there are also some [b]regular shelves and tables[/b] you can craft (or buy) for keeping your home nice and tidy.

[h2]Show your garden some extra love with the new compost[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f93d18120e4d7f37d032cd2c9ebbb6b658b1be51.png[/img]
Next to your home we have now placed a neat little [b]composting unit[/b] which will allow you to [b]convert green plants into useful fertilizer[/b].  You can then [b]use the fertilizer on tilled soil[/b] to [b]increase plant growth speed[/b] and [b]reduce the amount of water the plants need[/b] to fully grow.

Sounds super sweet if you ask me!

[h2]Plant system rework[/h2]
Gardening is a huge part of our game and of course it hasn’t missed out on our love in this update. We have made a [b]complete overhaul to the plant system[/b] which will result in [b]better performance[/b] along with [b]opening up new doors for us to implement new features[/b] such as wind (to come in the future), smoother growth and new potential interactions.

Some examples of the changes you’ll notice in this update is that [b]plants now consume water as they grow[/b] and the [b]growing process has been slowed down[/b] to more closely represent the intended feel of the final game. You’ll also notice it will be a bit [b]easier to harvest resources[/b] from fully grown plants without uprooting them completely as [b]they now need to be tilled in order to be completely uprooted[/b].

Our clever gardening magician Oliver has promised to dive deeper into this overhaul in a later post, so stay tuned!

[h2]Capture and display memories with the new in-game camera[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/6b093d7da40e251f65884d8230d5eea159067dee.jpg[/img]
Your tool shed has now been expanded and includes a nifty little [b]instant camera[/b]. Pick it up, snap some photos of your best friends and hang them up on display in your newly upgraded house.

If you ever feel like sharing your photos outside the game you can find them stored in the ‘Data’ folder in your Garden of the Sea save folder. It’s usually located in one of the numbered folders within ‘%USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Neat Corporation\\Garden of the Sea\\Saves’ (boy, that was a mouthful).

[h2]New - smoother - ways to move around[/h2]
You asked for it - and we listened! [b]Smooth locomotion[/b] along with [b]more options regarding snap turning[/b] has been added to the game in this update, so if you’re one of those cool cats that like to glide rather than teleport you’ll now be able to do so (you still need to teleport up steep hills though).

You can turn this on along with fine tuning your movement speed and acceleration from the [b]Settings tab in the in-game menu[/b].

[h2][SEASONAL] Fall has arrived to all islands[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/a3c9da00c331ae4ead61812cef92d549ad07c620.png[/img]
Do you love Fall as much as we do? Does the Halloween season always put a wide smile on your face? Then you’re gonna love the fact that [b]you can now enjoy the beautiful season of fall in Garden of the Sea[/b]! You’ll also find some sweet Halloween themed decorations which you can place around your garden and home. We hope you’ll enjoy this feature as much as we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/ef6e6f9cf07399e908ad6d01596f9959385f4dff.png[/img]

That’d be all for this time folks! If you want to get down into the nitty-gritty we’re also providing a full patch note list at the very bottom, but as always we’re loving the engagement and love you are showing, so keep the feedback coming! ♥️

Feel free to join the [url=http://discord.gg/NeatCorp]Neat Corp Discord[/url] if you haven’t already to share your thoughts, additional feedback or want to make us aware of any bugs you’ve encountered.

Until next time,
[b]// The Neat GotS team[/b]

notes.title: Merchant Patch Out On the Experimental Branch Now!
notes.content:
Hello again gardeners!

We are happy to announce the [b]launch of the Merchant patch onto our Experimental Branch[/b]! If you have time to go test it out, please do!

Since this is the Experimental Branch, please be aware that [b]some bugs are expected[/b] and that there’s an increased risk of game breaking situations occurring. This branch is mostly for all of you who want to [b]try all the newest things[/b] and help us out with making everything as awesome as possible for the main branch release!

[b]How to switch to the Experimental Branch:[/b]
[i][u]Note:[/u] Exact names of the options to press might differ depending on your Steam language settings.[/i]
[olist]
[*] Right click 'Garden of the Sea' in your Steam Library list and select 'Properties...'
[*] Go the tab 'BETAS'
[*] In the drop-down menu, select "experimental - Development branch"
[*] The game should then start an update in order to download the new branch
[*] When the update is finished, just run the game and start playing!
[/olist]
[b][u]Remember:[/u][/b] If you later want to go back to the regular branch you will have to repeat the above steps and re-select "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".

[h3]BE AWARE: Major save file changes will render your previous saves incompatible with the new update[/h3]
This patch is sadly not going to be compatible with your earlier saves. Even if they might load for you, many [b]features might be broken[/b] and we can’t guarantee what the experience might be. We strongly recommend that you [b]create a new save to ensure that everything works[/b] as intended.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c5c6d28f81a57bc144319645be63353ceb6e74e0.png[/img]

Let's dive into the full list of all the new systems and changes we've packed into this update:

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[h3]Merchant[/h3]
[i]He's finally awake! And boy is he happy to see you![/i]
[list]
[*] Use your farmed resources to [b]trade for new items[/b] in his shop!
[*] Allows you to [b]acquire new decorations[/b] for your island
[*] Restocks daily so be sure to check for [b]new items every day[/b]!
[/list]

[h3]House Upgrades[/h3]
[i]Is tent life not your style? Have no fear! House upgrades are here![/i]
[list]
[*] Start your adventure with a cozy tent
[*] [b]Two house upgrades available[/b] through quests
[*] Each upgrade adds new types of items to the merchants store
[*] Unlock new customization opportunities as your house grows!
[/list]

[h3]Plant System Rework[/h3]
[i]Plants are stealing the show with their new fancy system![/i]
[list]
[*] Complete overhaul of the plant system back-end for future-proofing performance and scalability
[*] Growth cycle of plants is now completely smooth
[*] [b]Major increase in performance[/b], at least by an order of magnitude
[*] [b]Plants now consume water[/b] as they grow, and [b]the growth process has been slowed down[/b] to more closely represent the feel of the final game
[*] Caring for your plants is now made easier with fertilizer [b]balls that can be acquired through the compost bin[/b]
[*] Plants that grow crafting resources will now need to be tilled in order to be completely uprooted
[*] Many other fixes and preparations for features will be arriving with future patches!
[/list]

[h3]Smooth Locomotion[/h3]
[i]Smoooooth! Oh so smooth![/i]
[list]
[*] After many requests it’s finally here, [b]smooth locomotion is added to the game[/b]
[*] Smooth locomotion can be enabled through the in-game menu
[*] Multiple options to tailor movement to your liking!
[/list]

[h2]Minor Features[/h2]
[i]Smaller (but just as neat!) systems for you to enjoy![/i]
[list]
[*] [b]In-game camera:[/b] Capture your favorite moments with our new instant camera!
[*] [b]Compost bin:[/b] Consumes excess plants to generate fertilizer
[*] [b]Pattern system:[/b] Further customize your fabrics with new patterns
[*] [b]New Decoration items:[/b] Additional decor items for both your home and your garden have been added
[*] [b]Storage:[/b] In-world storage items to alleviate inventory clutter
[*] [b]Loading Screen:[/b] The game now has a loading screen
[*] [b]Snap Turning:[/b] Snap turning was added alongside Smooth Locomotion for you who prefer a more snappy approach to movement
[*] [b][Seasonal] Fall:[/b] Fall is now here in the garden with updated foliage colors and seasonal plants and decor![/list]

notes.title: Merchant Patch Coming Soon!

We come to you with a much awaited post to bring you up to date on the upcoming [b]Merchant Patch[/b] along with some other goodies we’ve thrown into the bag.

[h3]The Merchant is almost here![/h3]
[b]The Merchant update[/b] is coming [i]soon[/i] (so so soon!)!! We are just wrapping up a few remaining bugs and loose ends before we release him and all his goodies onto the [i]experimental branch[/i] through steam, which you can opt in to and playtest early.

[b]He also sells pattern rolls[/b], which can be applied (crafted) onto the curtains and pillows for even more creative options to make your home as cozy as possible. The Merchant will accept berries, veggies, and flowers as trade goods for his items, and don’t even think about haggling the price down (trust us we’ve tried)! He runs a tight ship.

He’s got beds, books, posters, plushies, pillows, rugs, pattern rolls, cookware, chairs, tables, [b]you name it[/b]! You can then access the photos you’ve taken through the Garden of the Sea save folder on your computer (‘...\\Garden of the Sea\\Saves\\0\\Data’) in case you want to share them outside of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/6b093d7da40e251f65884d8230d5eea159067dee.jpg[/img]

Keep bringing us feedback on what you want to see and experience in Garden of the Sea and we will make sure it ends up on our list of things to-do! (Though that list is now getting…. [i]Very[/i] long.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/4beb8e5eb347f219685a28392bb53b82c398938e.png[/img]

Our clever gardening magician Oliver has also [b]updated the plant system[/b] which will result in better performance along with opening up new doors for us to implement new features such as wind, smoother growth and other potential interactions! (We’ll dive deeper into this in a later post, so stay tuned!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c971617da29bbce336fa38f11179d8a7d242575a.gif[/img]

[h3]House upgrades coming to an island near you![/h3]

In the largest home you can also [b]customize the colors of the walls, floors and roof[/b] using the Jellyfish painting blobs, so go wild!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/fa82e70489a2dd4cc353158ed568ea93afe9a533.png[/img]

notes.title: Fishing Patch out now!
notes.content:
[b]Gosh y’all [/b]- it’s been a while since we released a whole big patch for Garden of the Sea, but here we are with not one, not two, but [b]three really big updates for you[/b], bundled into one handy-dandy patch! We’d love to take a moment to tell you about all the juicy new code behind these updates, and what it means for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/9fe4c1d841525c1d84573992b81e2c9831ac37e5.jpg[/img]


[b]TLDR; 
[/b][list]
[*] Fishing mechanic/gameplay added.
[*] Painting system for all crafted items.
[*] New quest to unlock the boat, painting system, and fishing rod.
[*] Save system rework.
[/list]

At the beginning of 2020 we began work in earnest on reworking the system in Garden of the Sea which handles the [b]Save Game data.[/b] This was a huge undertaking, since we quickly learned that we would need to create a save system which future-proofs (as much as possible) for[b] future content updates[/b], and doesn’t just save stuff that’s been built in the past. That way everyone who has bought and played the game in the past can easily open up a newer version of Garden of the Sea and their save data will be intact, their progress saved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f582a924571c80245d10b3ef36c47726db8ad415.png[/img]


Once that was done, work started on our Fishing Patch. Alongside this, we also began work on what we are calling the Painting System. Both of these systems are designed to [b]broaden the interaction possibility with the other systems currently in-game[/b], and provide little moments of fun and customization that we felt fit really well within this universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3448a911940199facbde4367312e630d3186130.gif[/img]


[b]The painting system allows you to utilize the vibrant colors of several plants you’ve cultivated, mirroring their hues on any crafted item you have unlocked and built in the world[/b]. Make your house truly spectacular with bright purples and blues, or maybe set up a row of pastel fences around your precious radishes (you can never be too careful with those cheeky puffkins around). We really want to open up the door to even more customization and personalization in your garden, and making this island your home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/848dd00ada75fb92585d169fb3af6c77fb8b0c7b.jpg[/img]


The fishing system was a natural extension of the in-game boat (our ode to smooth locomotion) and something that [b]we always knew was going to exist in the game[/b], but we were never sure exactly [i]_how_ [/i]it would exist. Would you have a hook? Was the game easy with no skill-check? Was it difficult with no fail-state? Was it frustrating, or relaxing? In the end I think we landed on a good balance of the above, in large part thanks to the help and feedback of our wonderful [url=discord.gg/neatcorp]Discord community[/url]. The fish also have a pond to help nurture the fishies you’ve found and brought home to your island.

So without further ado - [b]here are the patch notes for this Fishing, Painting, and Save System update for Garden of the Sea[/b]:

[h2]Bigger stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Save system overhaul (now built to be far more robust for future updates).
[*] Fishing mechanic first version implemented (yay!).
[*] Fish system for pools of fish in the ocean of varying types.
[*] Quest-line implemented for unlocking the boat.
[*] Painting system for customizing crafted items implemented.
[*] Quest-line added for paint blob recipes and functionality.
[/list]

[h2]Smaller stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] New pot-pot animations added and implemented.
[*] Art polish and tweaks on several plant types and textures in-game.
[*] Fishing pond added near home to house new fishies.
[*] Fishing rod island for acquiring fishing rod implemented.
[*] Seagull creature added to indicate fish regions.
[*] Cave area added on back side of tallest island.
[*] Colors for all crafted items implemented.
[*] Colors for tools now implemented.
[*] New VFX for fishing, painting, and potpot anims implemented.
[*] Pre-populated planter box recipes added.
[*] Several new fish types added with dynamic fish colors for fishing system.
[*] Sound and music for new mechanics and systems implemented.
[*] Updated to latest version of gestrument.
[*] Rumble haptics fixed for most hardware.
[*] Index grabbing functionality tweaked to feel better.
[/list]

[b]Good to know
[/b]Save files are now saved in %userprofile%/AppData/LocalLow/Neat Corporation/Garden of the Sea/Saves instead of your Documents folder
It will not be possible to load your old save files, even if you copy them to the new directory

notes.title: Fishing Patch update, what's on the horizon, and a pricing update for Garden of the Sea!

In the future, we want to add a [b]deeper interaction system with the creatures[/b], a [b]day/night cycle[/b], support for [b]more hardware[/b], more [b]islands with new plants, quests, and recipes[/b], along with new systems like [b]wearables, breeding, cooking, and more.[/b] This list of things we want to build for Garden of the Sea is ever-growing and ever-changing with the feedback and conversations we have with all of you, our Early Access-ees (is that a word? We plan on[b] rolling out this new price in a couple weeks[/b] (most likely on June 1st) along with the [b]release of the Fishing Patch on the public branch of the game[/b]. The new price is meant to not only reflect the amount of work that has gone into the game, but also help us get closer to what we believe the final selling price of the game will be once it goes out of Early Access.

[b]Thank you for helping us get to this point,[/b] we can't wait to build what's coming up next alongside you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f1db9c1f782e12de0f035f0814f65c0f73a17adc.gif[/img]

First things first - we made sure to add some fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/f582a924571c80245d10b3ef36c47726db8ad415.png[/img]

We've got several types of fish now, and variations within each type, so you will have plenty of fish in your sea! Each type of fish will create resources for you once you have put them in your pond. One of the resources that you can get is a lil jelly ball from the jellyfish (you dont wanna know how you get it... it just.... appears. trust me) which can then be used to craft paintballs for customizing all your crafted items! We're definitely gonna start seeing some wacky color combinations soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3448a911940199facbde4367312e630d3186130.gif[/img]

It hasn't all been fun and games though - we have run into a few "happy little accidents" along the way, like that one time we accidentally got giant tomatoes when we were refactoring the plant growing code... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/c3648cc77366a6c969aa98fb144e86aa7445dde0.jpg[/img]

or when we accidentally built Fortnite in VR...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/125a38fd0ce1d5dfc4075b87c3f24883ed30104e.gif[/img]

We have also been fixing a few smaller things you've been asking for though. For instance, if you toss an object into the water it will now (in most cases) float back to shore so you can grab it again. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/6ca0d9b0b6fcdcb70b2071c7bad54f6e3242f098.gif[/img]

We aren't done yet with all the tweaks to the fishing system, but we are gearing up for an open beta of that patch soon, and would love to get your feedback on it. If you'd like to give the new mechanics a try before they go live on the main branch on steam, join us over on [url=discord.gg/NeatCorp]our Neat Corp Discord[/url]! We look forward to chatting and hearing your thoughts and ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/dfbbd0cc8c6175d73fb574450e34fa1435b36ce4.jpg[/img]

We can't wait to share fishing (and all the other updates this patch will contain) with you all! Stay tuned for the patch release, coming "soon" (when it's ready!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130380/848dd00ada75fb92585d169fb3af6c77fb8b0c7b.jpg[/img]

Warmest wishes from the GotS team!



oh... and cat tax (one of our developers cats "tribble" attacking the new in-game seaguls)

notes.title: Patch #2 is live!
notes.content:
Hello gardeners! We have uploaded a new build for Garden of the Sea on Steam, please try it out! 

What's new:
- Index and Knuckles first pass implementation
- More bugfixes related to saving/loading
- 2 new crafting recipes and 1 new flower type
- Improved watering can interaction

If you have any issues with saving and loading in this build, please upload your save files in #bugs over on our discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/NeatCorp]https://discord.gg/NeatCorp[/url] or at [url=https://gots.userecho.com/]https://gots.userecho.com/[/url]. The save files are located in "C:/Users/YOURUSERNAME/Documents/Garden of the Sea Save Data"

Please be aware that due to the early access nature of the game, this update may break your current save files. We are sorry for the inconvenience and are working on a  more robust save system for the game.

Please don't hesitate to report bugs or make suggestions - we need your help to make this game the best it can be!
